# DKAINSWORLD

> Dylan’s secondhand store in Fremont, California: tools, boards, furniture, backpacks and flea-market finds. Call or text Dylan to confirm an item before you come by.

## Payments
- Zelle: (510) 435-0747 or dkain1017dk@gmail.com
- Cash App and PayPal: dkain1017dk@gmail.com
- Chime: ask Dylan

## Terms
- Most items are secondhand (used or lightly used); new items are marked new. All items are sold as-is. All sales are final.
- Inspect the item while there and again in your vehicle before leaving. Once money is exchanged and you drive off, the sale is final.
- Contact Dylan within 1 hour of buying if there is a problem.
- DKAIN Bucks (store credit): a maybe, not a promise. Same day, unused, same working condition: Dylan might negotiate and give DKAIN Bucks to use on another item.
- Trade in or bring in items to earn DKAIN Bucks, or buy them for yourself or a loved one; apply them to an item later or pay the difference. Terms and limits apply.
- Prices are as of posting and subject to change (most likely lower). Ask Dylan for today’s price.
